latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Video Editing with Blender Tutorial":

- Lets you upload Blender screen recordings and edit them into structured video tutorials.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB, with AI-guided editing in the cloud (1–2 minutes processing).
- Outputs high-quality 1080p MP4 files suitable for platforms like YouTube.
- No local installation needed; just drop your video and describe the edits you want.
- Session management, credits, and uploads handled via a simple chat workflow.
